newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mabuhay buys 51 pct stake in hotel.
newsitem.headline: Mabuhay buys 51 pct stake in hotel.

text.p: Mabuhay Holdings Corp said on Friday it had bought a 51 percent stake in the five-star Westin Philippine Plaza Hotel from Allied Kajima Ltd.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Mabuhay said it will pay a total 1.53 billion pesos to Japan-based Allied Kajima for the purchase of a 51 percent interest in the 670-room hotel along Manila Bay.

Mabuhay said it paid 20 million pesos on Friday and will pay another 10 percent upon signing of the sales and purchase agreement with the balance due 30 days after. No date for signing of the sales agreement was mentioned.
"With the shifting of the development focus to the Manila Bay area, the management sees an opportunity to develop the unutilised portions of the Westin Philippine Plaza site," the company said.
The purchase, according to Mabuhay, will have no material effect on its financial position for this year but will contribute positively to future earnings of the company.
Mabuhay is a holding company with interests in real estate, power and shipping. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418939 fax 8176267
